title: Independently verify immutable published dw.quantities package and live binary consumer from NUGET_LOCAL
commitMessage: test: verify published dw.quantities binary from local NuGet feed

contribution.summary: Independently re-read the operator-published dw.quantities calendar NuGet archive from NUGET_LOCAL and compile a fresh exact PackageReference consumer against its immutable loaded DLL.
contribution.value: Verify the exact RS135 archive/DLL SHA-256 against actual shared-feed bytes using published Dw.Tools.NuGet inspection, run four isolated source-free binary controls, and record durable DWF evidence without publishing or changing Math product scope.
debtChanges: Operator terminal output reports private publication and binary PASS, but the DWF receipt must independently authenticate actual physical shared-feed bytes.
Only dw.quantities 20260.20261102.1001 is qualified; the twelve other Math packages and their dependency closures remain separate release gates.
No public registry publication, new public license, other OS certification, installed-package rollback or crash-recovery guarantee is implied.
Previous RS134-RS136 source-pinned receipts remain historical and immutable; RS137 must not replay --publish or rewrite any prior package identity.
contribution.nextAction: After RS137 verifies the published package, qualify dw.quantities.expression and dw.quantities.standard with exact dependencies and isolated binary consumers; publish subsequent packages only after their own qualified immutable local-release gates.
